title: Design a News Feed
prompt: Design a news feed system like Facebook or Twitter's timeline: users follow other users, and see a feed of recent posts from the people they follow, roughly ordered by recency.
requirements: Functional: create a post, follow/unfollow, fetch a personalized feed of recent posts from followed users
Non-functional: some users follow only a handful of people, some celebrities have tens of millions of followers; feed reads should be fast even under that skew
discussion_points: Fan-out on write (push to every follower's feed) vs fan-out on read (compute the feed at request time) vs a hybrid
How the hybrid approach handles the celebrity/hot-user case specifically
Storage for the feed itself vs the underlying posts
Pagination and how new posts get merged in without breaking a user's scroll position
Where ranking (not just chronological order) would fit into this architecture
